rvis: interactive charts and shiny dashboards

Source: R/rvis.R
rvis.Rd

rvis draws interactive charts with about 30 plotting packages using one calling convention, rvisPlot(), and builds shiny dashboards from a YAML or JSON configuration with rvisDashboard(). Clicks on chart items can be shiny inputs (rvisClickEvents()).

Learn rvis

Start with the Get started article, then the chart guides and the dashboard guides of the package website (also available as vignettes: browseVignettes("rvis")). Examples and galleries lists all examples.

Class DASHBOARD

Dashboards are objects of the reference class DASHBOARD: their items (inputs, outputs and containers), layout and services. They are made by rvisDashboard() and run by their run() method or runDashboard().
